checks.applicability: Applies to pages on which the library is detected: its window global (with its version field) or, for jQuery, Bootstrap, AngularJS, Lodash and Handlebars, a script URL whose path names the library and a version.
checks.expectation: Fails for every Bootstrap before 4.0.0 (end of life; every community release is covered by an advisory) and for 4.x below 4.3.1; 4.3.1 and later pass. Detected through `bootstrap.Tooltip.VERSION`, a `data-bs-version` attribute, or a script path naming the core build (bootstrap.min.js, bootstrap.bundle.min.js, bootstrap@4.1.3). A plugin named after Bootstrap (bootstrap-datepicker) is not Bootstrap. A page without the library: not applicable. A page that breaks the detection scripts (result missing or malformed) is not run for every library, never clean.
